title: The Catokwacopa advertisements, The Standard, 8 and 20 May 1875 (Schmeh Top 50 no. 8)

documents.shelfmark: The Standard, p. 1 col. 2, 8 and 20 May 1875

plaintext.source: Only competing modern blog readings (Bosbach, Estes, Ernst, Krajčovič); no authoritative plaintext.

transcription.notes: Letter totals 222 and 219 from NOTES; the text lives in ads.py (Python), which --measure cannot read, so not measured. The two ads are halves of one text, attacked as one unit.

system.summary: Each plaintext phrase split into two order-preserving halves, one per advertisement, with letters dropped; nothing substituted.
system.notes: The type enum has no 'split with omissions'; transposition is the nearest. Numerals and dashes sit in the same slots in both ads; the pairing of lines beats 100,000 random re-pairings.

prior_solution.where: Cipherbrain / klausschmeh.net threads 2015-2026: DYING DECLARATION, the Oxford vocabulary, QUI FIT, Ernst's and Krajcovic's 2026 readings

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded. Fourth session (24-25 Oct 2026): George Lasry supplied the circulating text and the blog images, approved the corpus fetches, and relayed suggestions from a parallel session (line 19 OPPOSITE USED MOTTO, HOLY ORDERS XAMN) for checking.
tools: fit.py (exact-fit DP: minimum misprints and omissions of a candidate, both transcriptions)
search2.py (trie search, 51k-word bigram model, omission-habit penalties, onset prior; driver.py diversity rounds)
scan_horace.py (initial-letter abbreviation scan over Horace, Latin Library text)
build_vocab.py / build_vocab_la.py (word models from lang/corpora en-gutenberg and la-gutenberg)

solution.what: Permutation test of line-length differences: the line pairing is structural (no random re-pairing in 100,000 comes as close).
Positional rule: consonant-initial words begin in the 8 May half, vowel-initial mostly in the 20 May half.
Exact omission/misprint costs of every published reading; DYING DECLARATION exact, SIGNED and MASTER PUPIL need misprints.
Open-vocabulary search over 30,000 words, with and without names; new exact readings for lines 18, 21, 14.
Name-frame test with 1,645 proper nouns: CONINGTON, JOWETT, SHIRLEY and HERTFORD are each the only name that fits.
Latin vocabulary search on line 29 (control: line 17 returns QUI FIT first).

Looked for images to re-transcribe: the klausschmeh.net images (img/) are re-typeset from the pre-2018 text (Hfsclam, 139, Eftdorshpxn ...), not scans; the BNA originals are paywalled, so no re-transcription was possible.

Phrase-level search (beam.py): letter-by-letter plaintext under the lang en-modern 5-gram, vocabulary-constrained, on lines 5, 6, 9, 12, 14, 19, 21, 23, 26, 29. Controls (7, 18, 3) come out on top; every open line gives junk.

Sense measure (measure.py): a character counts only if a misprint-free, forced reading consumes it and the words score as English. The 0.747 figure had counted lines 5, 6, 13, 19, 20 and 21 on proposals with misprints or no reading. Result 257/470 = 0.547 (8 May 0.563, 20 May 0.530).

Exact-fit DP (fit.py) on every published and pasted reading, both transcriptions: the lecture lines read CONINGTON'S / JOWETT'S LECTURES with 0 misprints (the S is possessive, not LECSURS); MASTER PUPIL, SAID SIMPLY ... CHARACTER, SUMMONER, QUIFFED, SIGNED need misprints.

Trie search (search2.py) with a bigram model from the 24 Gutenberg novels plus Oxford vocabulary, omission penalties by letter class, onset prior; controls 3, 4, 7, 8, 16, 17, 24, 25, 27, 28 first; open lines 5, 6, 9, 12, 19, 21, 23, 26, 29 give junk; 150-deep lists and diversity rounds filed.

Lines 10 and 21 share the ending am/xn = XAMN ('Examn.'): HERTFORD SCHOLARSHIP XAMN costs 2 omissions instead of 12; EXAMINATION forced at the end of line 21, first word open (HOLIDAYS 3, HOLY ORDERS 5).
Third stream: are the omitted letters in the March 1875 TITOLLUM ad? About 60 letters, far too few.

'1. 6. 9.' / 'Cotegr' = Horace Odes 1.6.9 'conamur tenues grandia', CO-TE-GR the first two letters of each word, exact; hence A.P. 138 = Ars Poetica 138 'quid dignum tanto feret hic promissor hiatu' (not annual pay). Neither in the 2018 or 2026 threads.
scan_horace.py: every run of words in Horace with 1-3 initial letters per word, exact merge. Cotegr: 'conamur tenues grandia' is the only two-letter match; lines 9, 26, 29, 12: no match.
Latin word search (la-gutenberg, 110k forms; control QUI FIT first) on lines 9, 26, 29, 12: junk; the Gutenberg Latin editions leak English words.
Word-structure prior (fragments per word in the 8 May half) and omission caps 5/3: controls unchanged, open lines unchanged.

George's images of both ads match the circulating text letter for letter, including the seven tokens Ernst corrected; they are the blog's re-typeset illustrations, not scans, so Ernst's BNA text stands (138/138 alignment, HERTFORD exact only with Hrsclam).

outcome.method_basis: The lines counted read are the published readings (Bosbach's DYING DECLARATION, the Estes/'Dave' Oxford vocabulary, Krajcovic's QUI FIT, Ernst's transcription on klausschmeh.net and Cipherbrain); the project costed each exactly, confirmed the forced lines with an open-vocabulary search, and found exact alternatives for lines 14, 18 and 21. Fourth session (24-25 Oct 2026) added four readings of its own under the omission scheme: the possessive S of lines 8 and 25, the shared XAMN of lines 10 and 21, Horace Odes 1.6.9 for line 13 and Ars Poetica 138 for line 20; none is in the blog threads.
outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/catokwacopa/measure.py: alphanumeric characters of both ads (470); a character counts only when a misprint-free reading forced by the letters (top of search.py or beam.py, or a one-name frame) consumes it and the words score as English under lang en-modern; 257 read (8 May 134/238, 20 May 123/232).
outcome.notes: Oxford reading right in outline. Measured 5 Oct 2026 by sense (0.547); the 21 Sept 0.747 counted every line with any proposal, including readings needing 1-11 misprints and two lines with no reading. key 'not applicable': omission scheme, no key. 25 Oct 2026: lines 13 and 20 now read (Horace); measure.py not re-run (skip-worktree), 276/470 = 0.587 if their 19 characters are counted. contribution 'decipherment with ambiguous key' = readings under the non-mechanical omission scheme.
